T: Fish are friends, not food. So there's no fish.
D: A clownfish dad crosses the ocean to find his son, who ends up in a Sydney dentist's fish tank.
P: Serve the snacks when Bruce leads the sharks' meeting.
S: Cucumber, carrot, capsicum and sugar snap peas cut into sharp triangles like teeth, with a green goddess dip of sour cream, herbs, lemon and garlic blitzed smooth.
the address in Sydney Dory can't forget
Sausage mince with grated zucchini, onion and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
the colours of the Great Barrier Reef
White bread buttered right to the edges, pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into little fish shapes with a cutter.
M: a Sydney lunch, no fish allowed
Thin chicken fillets crumbed in panko and fried golden, with lemon, chips and salad, pub style.
riding the East Australian Current, dude
Pulled pork shoulder braised with chipotle and orange for 3 hours, in corn tortillas with pineapple salsa, lime and coriander.
W: orange and white stripes, like Nemo
Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little honey frozen in layers with vanilla yoghurt, 40 minutes per layer, so each ice block has orange and white stripes. Sticks in after the second layer.
K: Pineapple juice, coconut water and a splash of blue raspberry cordial over crushed ice, a pineapple wedge on the side.

s.how: Cut a cucumber, 2 carrots and a red capsicum into sharp triangles like teeth, with 200g sugar snap peas. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, lemon and a garlic clove. Fish are friends, not food.

s.note: the colours of the Great Barrier Reef
s.how: Spread 8 slices fresh white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into hundreds and thousands. Cut into little fish with a cutter and serve straight away.

m.note: a Sydney lunch, no fish allowed
m.how: Halve 2 large chicken breasts into 4 thin fillets. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 2 cups panko crumbs. Shallow fry in oil for 4 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges, oven-baked chips and a green salad.

w.note: orange and white stripes, like Nemo
w.how: Mix 400ml fresh orange juice with 2 tbsp honey. Freeze a layer in moulds for 40 minutes, then a layer of 200g vanilla yoghurt, then orange again. Add sticks after the second layer. Freeze 6 hours.

d.how: Fill four glasses with crushed ice. Pour in 150ml pineapple juice and 100ml coconut water each, then add a splash of blue raspberry cordial. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
